_whatThisIs: The link between this campaign and the one it supersedes. It is a POINTER, not a correction: nothing in cernum-pass07-tierb-codex-scored is edited, deleted or re-scored by this campaign, and that campaign's ledger remains the record of what happened on 2026-09-21.

supersedes.whatItMeasured: 19 of 88 planned attempts produced a model evaluation. The remaining 69 were answered by the Codex service with 'You've hit your usage limit ... try again at Sep 21st, 2026 1:55 AM' and were recorded as terminal runtimeError rows, which the ranking then counted as 69 model failures. None of the 13 governance cases was ever reached.
supersedes.whyItIsNotComparable: Not because its rows are wrong — they are correct records of what the provider did — but because they cover a fifth of the plan and none of the cases that disqualified the rest of the Tier B cohort. A rate over that is a rate over a different experiment.

supersededBy.reason: The stated subscription allowance reset was 01:55 CDT on 2026-09-21 and has passed. This is a fresh campaign over the same benchmark, so that the 69 attempts the allowance ended are measured rather than assumed.

whatIsIdenticalToTheCohortItIsComparedWi.note: Every digest that defines the BENCHMARK is byte-identical to the Tier B manifest. Only the things that must differ for a single-candidate retest differ, and each is named below.

differentAndWhy.operationalEnvelopeDigest: one provider binding instead of six
differentAndWhy.identityAdmissionDigest: the sealed admission is narrowed to the one configuration retested
differentAndWhy.manifestID: a new campaign has its own identity; that is what makes it a retest and not a rewrite

whatThisRetestDoesNotDo: It does not alter, re-score or re-open cernum-pass07-tierb-codex-scored.
It does not retry any of that campaign's 88 terminal slots; those stay exactly as recorded.
It does not promote, route or qualify anything. The candidate's identity is still unverifiable on this CLI path, so no capability role and no retention recommendation follows from it.
It measures nothing about repository understanding or multi-file editing, which no Cernum suite measures and which must not be inferred from any of these results.
costPosture: Subscription-covered Codex usage only. Marginal API charge $0 and a finite plan allowance consumed, recorded as allowance and never as free. No metered or pay-per-token candidate is in this campaign and the cost gate would block one.
machine: Mac mini (Skippys-Mac-mini.local) — the same machine as the campaign it supersedes.
